before: In March 2026, a motorcyclist was killed on Dorchester Road at the intersection with Forest Hills Drive — struck by a heavy-duty pickup truck. It wasn't the first fatal motorcycle crash on this corridor. It won't be the last.
after: On March 2, 2026, a motorcyclist was killed on Dorchester Road at the intersection with Forest Hills Drive — in a collision with a heavy-duty pickup truck. Police said no charges were expected. SCDOT's road safety audit counted 17 fatal crashes and 924 injury crashes on Dorchester Road between the Dorchester County line and Kent Avenue from 2018 through 2022.

before:
Nationally, left-turning vehicles cause 42% of fatal motorcycle crashes (NHTSA data). On Dorchester Road, this statistic comes to life at every unprotected left-turn intersection:

  • A car waits to turn left
  • The driver scans oncoming traffic but fails to register an approaching motorcycle (smaller visual profile = perceived as farther away)
  • The driver turns directly into the motorcycle's path
  • At 50 mph, the rider has less than 2 seconds to react

The Forest Hills Drive intersection, Bacons Bridge Road, and the Ashley Phosphate junction all follow this deadly pattern.
after:
Nationally, in 45% of fatal crashes between a motorcycle and one other vehicle, the other vehicle was turning left (NHTSA, 2024 data). On Dorchester Road, this statistic comes to life at every unprotected left-turn intersection:

  • A car waits to turn left
  • The driver scans oncoming traffic but fails to register an approaching motorcycle (smaller visual profile = perceived as farther away)
  • The driver turns directly into the motorcycle's path
  • At 50 mph, a motorcycle covers about 73 feet every second

In Dorchester County, the Dorchester Road intersections with Old Trolley Road, Ladson Road and Bacons Bridge Road were three of the county's five highest-crash intersections in 2024 (SCDPS).
